segments.text: Kal kya ho gaya tha aapka mobile ko?
Pata nahi, chal nahi raha tha.
Kal kitna baar dusra recharge karke bhi phone kiya tha.
To fir, are yaar, mera mobile kharab ho gaya na yaar.
Tum kahan, tum kahan par ho?

full_text: Hello. Hello. Kal kya ho gaya tha aapka mobile ko? Pata nahi, chal nahi raha tha. Kal kitna baar dusra recharge karke bhi phone kiya tha. Tumne? Haan. To fir, are yaar, mera mobile kharab ho gaya na yaar. Aisa hai. Chhat pe aayi ho kya? Chhat pe aayi ho? Haan. Chhat pe aayi hoon main. Tum kahan, tum kahan par ho? Ghar pe. Hello. Hello. Haan. Hello. Bolo, bolo, bolo, bolo. Mobile bahut chipakta hai.
